Figure 1:(a) Relational semantic inertia: the ‘person–cup/glass/bottle’ pair persists across frames, but its relation changes fromlooking attonot looking at, while the baseline[9]retains the previous predicate in the target frame.
(b) Our reimplementation of the baseline exhibits an 11.6-point gap in SGDET R@10 between the non-transition and relation-transition frame subsets.

Figure 2:Overall framework of RTAformer.
(a) Frame-wise spatial triplet parsing produces instance-pair and relation queries for target and reference frames.
(b) Disentangled Temporal Aggregation (DTA) refines the target queries with separate instance and relation streams, where TADI injects relation-transition cues.
FFN heads produce the instance and relation predictions that form the output triplets.
(c) Spatio-Semantic Instance Alignment (SSIA) aligns adjacent-frame instance-pair queries during training.

Figure 5:Qualitative comparison around relation transition boundaries.
The participating entities remain visible across adjacent frames, while predicates for ‘person–broom’ and ‘person–door’ change.
RTAformer updates the changed predicates, e.g., ‘person–holding–broom’ and ‘person–not contacting–door’, whereas OED preserves previous-frame relations such as ‘person–not contacting–broom’ and ‘person–touching–door’.
